name: EgoBody
summary: 交互场景中的第一人称与多视角同步人体动作观测。
summaryEn: Synchronized egocentric and multiview observations of human motion in interactive scenes.
scaleZh: 125 段序列；36 人；15 个室内场景
access: Registration and acceptance of the data license required
accessZh: 需注册并签署数据许可
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 原始论文为 2021 年，完整模态于 2022 年发布；自动拟合并非无误差真值。
wmNoteEn: Original paper in 2021, full modalities released in 2022; fitted body annotations are not error-free truth.

evidence.statement: The dataset documents synchronized Kinect and egocentric frames, sequence start/end frame IDs and 3D body motion annotations. These provide ordered human-state trajectories in scenes.

yearBasis.description: Original preprint in December 2021; README dates full-modality release to 2022-10-20.
